response.overview: Every Living Thing is an India–Canada–United Arab Emirates co-production, directed by award-winning filmmaker Uzair Merchant and narrated by the legendary Kabir Bedi. Filmed across seven countries, the documentary brings together scientists, policymakers, educators, innovators, entrepreneurs, and communities to present a deeply human and cinematic perspective on water, resilience, and our shared future. More than a documentary, we see Every Living Thing as the catalyst for a global conversation. Alongside the film, we are building an impact ecosystem through educational outreach, community engagement, strategic partnerships, and international collaborations to extend its reach beyond the screen.
response.title: Every Living Thing
